title: Keymode
description: The keymode module displays the current keyboard mode (e.g. "resize", "default") in the Mango compositor. It is hidden when no mode is active.

placeholders.description: The name of the current keymode.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how the mode should be displayed. {mode} is replaced by the current mode name.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.doc: Action that pops up a menu.
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file.
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables the module to consume all leftover space.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

patterns.label: Format <mode>
patterns.description: Provide a custom format for a specific keymode. <mode> is the mode name as reported by Mango (e.g. "resize"). The value can contain {mode} as a placeholder. If this option is set, it overrides the main format for that mode.
